reviewContext.issueReference: tacogips/riela#188 (https://github.com/tacogips/riela/issues/188); workflowExecutionId opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-1; plans accepted by step5-impl-plan-review comm-000010
reviewContext.userProblem: ART's hourly Notion persistence (publish fanout running riela/notion-gateway-write) can run for hours: on 2026-11-10 failed creates took ~337 s each with mutationOutcome=unknown and a pure riela/json-route step took up to 1049 s. Riela has no whole-save-job deadline covering waits/backoff and no bounded, mutation-safe retry/backoff for add-on save steps.
requiredOutcomes: Optional WorkflowStepRef fields deadlineMs (whole-step deadline anchored at readyAt = max(input message time, run start), fanout dispatch time for branch entry steps) and retry {maxAttempts, initialDelayMs, multiplier, maxDelayMs, jitter} on add-on steps; existing timeoutMs stays the per-attempt timeout (design §3).

Bounded exponential backoff with Retry-After raising the delay, retry-after-exceeds-max-delay stop, budget check before sleeping, deterministic jitter, and cancellation-aware sleeps through an injected WorkflowRetryClock (design §3.3, §5.4).

Step supervisor that actively expires projection, attempts and backoff at stepDeadline + 5 s backstop without awaiting non-cooperative children, with a dispatch guard and stale-attempt-timer handling (design §5.1, §5.2).

Mutation safety: retry only when isRetryable == true and effectOutcome != unknown; Notion classification with ordered write precedence (unknown always wins, missing mutationOutcome = unknown, 429/409 rejected retryable, other rejected and notDispatched permanent), fail-safe isMutation, publishPage taint rule (design §4).
Fanout expiry: unscheduled local-fanout branches whose entry step authors deadlineMs become failed join records (attempts=0, stopReason=step-deadline) at dispatchAt + deadlineMs (design §5.3).
Path-qualified validation of the new fields (ranges, retry requires deadlineMs, step timeoutMs <= deadlineMs, add-on only, no writeRetry nesting, no placement) (design §6).
Diagnostics: riela.step.attempt.finished / riela.step.retry.stopped backend events, [rielaRetry ...] failure suffix, riela.step.publication.duration telemetry (design §7).
User docs docs/workflows/step-deadline-and-retry.md and a Notion classification subsection in docs/builtin-gateway-json.md, including the exact ART settings of design §9.
nonGoals: Fixing runtime CPU, history or scheduling overhead (only bounded and observable).
A run-level deadline; scheduled overlap policy remains the whole-run bound.
Retry for agent/stdio/placement steps; reclassifying add-ons other than Notion.
Automatic Notion reconciliation or idempotency keys; notion-gateway change or pin bump.
Changing resume/rerun semantics; refactoring RielaAdapters executeWithRetry; DynamicWorkflowPolicy or GraphQL/SDL changes.
Any ART or running RielaApp modification; examples/ fixture.
constraints: Run swift build/test/swiftlint from the repository root via arch -arm64 /bin/zsh -lc, in the foreground, with focused --filter suites; never delete .build (shared SwiftPM cache).
Evidence and logs only under tmp/issue-188/ (untracked); never commit them.

Workers share one working tree: no git commit/stash/checkout/branch; re-read files before editing and record pre/post SHA-256; edit only own writePaths; sibling-only compile errors are logged as sibling-blocked and re-run later.
No real sleeps in tests (fake WorkflowRetryClock), no live Notion calls, no credential access.
Steps without deadlineMs/retry keep byte-identical behaviour; Notion error message text unchanged.

Serial integration runs full swift build, the union focused+regression filter (must show testBranchEntryDeadlineAnchoredAtFanoutDispatch passing) and swiftlint, then one commit and push to origin/main.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Reuse timeoutMs as the per-attempt timeout and add deadlineMs as the whole-step budget instead of a new attempt-timeout field.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Existing deadline(for:) precedence is kept; an HTTP/attempt timeout is not represented as a save-job deadline (design §2, §3.2).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: AdapterExecutionError.isRetryable/retryAfter plus a new optional effectOutcome are the only retry-eligibility signals; unknown is never retried.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Ambiguous non-idempotent Notion writes must not be repeated (design §4, §4.1).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Supervisor uses an unstructured child Task raced with lock-protected once-flag timers, never withThrowingTaskGroup.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: A task group awaits non-cooperative children, which is the hang this design fixes (design §5.1).
The gateway already reports mutationOutcome, Retry-After, httpStatus and has no internal retry, so retries do not multiply (design §8).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: retry cannot be combined with addon config.writeRetry.
Unresolved items are retained via fanout collect-partial failed join records; cross-run backlog belongs to ART.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Riela keeps runtime evidence only; timed-out work is never marked completed (design §9).

intentionalTradeoffs: Cross-workflow fanout branches are only elapsed-accounted (fail at start with attempts=0), not actively expired while queued; ART's publish fanout is local.
Runtime CPU and store-write latency are measured, not bounded; the bound is stepDeadline + 5 s plus the outcome store write.
A success returned before expiry is published even if the store write runs past the deadline (exceededAfterSuccess event).
Wave siblings share one working tree and .build; mitigated by the sibling-blocked re-run rule and serial integration.
Plan 05's per-plan filter relies on a regex lookahead; a full-class fallback is specified.
supportedEdgeCases: Stuck non-cooperative adapter or attachment projector (runner backstop, no late dispatch).
Transient 429/409 rejected with Retry-After, total-budget exhaustion, Retry-After above maxDelayMs, retry exhaustion.
Ambiguous writes: 5xx/transport after dispatch, missing mutationOutcome, partial ensurePagePath, appendBlocks after createPage.
Deadline already passed before dispatch (attempts=0, queueWaitMs) and slow pure-routing steps.
Fanout slot wait expiry, all-finished-before-deadline, fail-fast with deadline.
Invalid policies with path-qualified diagnostics; resumed runs anchoring at the new runStartedAt.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Active expiry of queued cross-workflow fanout branches.
Automatic reconciliation of effectOutcome=unknown Notion items.
Blocking resume/rerun of outcome-unknown steps (QA Q2 default: unchanged).
Retries for non-Notion gateways, agent, stdio and placement steps.
residualRisks: Supervisor concurrency complexity (once-guard, timer generations) covered by StepRetryPolicyTests cases 1, 11, 12 and 18 run 3 times.
Shared working tree/.build across wave siblings.
